FROM gold.vw_fact_sales

UNION ALL

FROM gold.vw_fact_inventory

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

FROM gold.vw_fact_leads

UNION ALL

FROM gold.vw_dim_vehicle_model

UNION ALL
SELECT 'dim_showroom', COUNT(*)
FROM gold.vw_dim_showroom

UNION ALL
SELECT 'dim_salesperson', COUNT(*)
FROM gold.vw_dim_salesperson

UNION ALL
SELECT 'dim_customer', COUNT(*)
FROM gold.vw_dim_customer

UNION ALL

FROM gold.vw_dim_campaign

FROM gold.vw_dim_date;
